item: plan card: feedback input + split Approve button
branch: typed text rides every decision on the perm bridge message; split menu holds the mode rows
provenance: permission_request is ChatPanel's synthetic shape (input/suggestions as raw JSON strings), copied from fixtures 11/40. The setMode acceptEdits suggestion shape is the CLI's, measured in docs/ide-mcp-protocol.md 207-211. The NEW footer contract (input .plan-fb, .split .ok/.ok.more, .card-menu rows, text field on the perm payload) is this feature's own — self-consistency evidence only; the Kotlin delivery of `text` is verified on the live wire, not here. __bridge is taped (sandbox-only run; port-isolated from any real IDE panel). The system broadcast frames in the mode-row steps carry only the field the handler keys on (permissionMode on a system event, docs/ide-mcp-protocol.md 204) — the deferred mode switch exists because an immediate set_permission_mode always lost to the CLI's prePlanMode restore (measured live 2026-08-16).
